entries.title: Smart 404 suggestions on a missing public page (desktop).
entries.notes: Captured anonymously from the installed App at the exact desktop missing-page route. The runner receipt preserves HTTP 404, clean source provenance, and zero browser/backend diagnostics.
entries.useCase: A visitor reaches a missing desktop page and receives useful, privacy-safe next steps.

entries.title: Smart 404 suggestions on a missing public page (mobile).
entries.notes: Captured anonymously from the installed App at the exact mobile missing-page route. The runner receipt preserves HTTP 404, clean source provenance, and zero browser/backend diagnostics.
entries.useCase: A mobile visitor reaches a missing page and can select a useful next step.

entries.title: Smart 404 settings.
entries.notes: Captured from the installed App's filtered Extensions management action with an authenticated administrator. The runner receipt records the admin profile, HTTP 200, clean source provenance, and zero browser/backend diagnostics.
entries.useCase: A site owner enables Smart 404 and chooses the maximum number of suggestions.

notes: All three route-backed entries were captured in light and dark modes through the shared runner from an isolated installed App and promoted only after receipt validation and human visual review. `promotionRequired` keeps Marketplace references fail-closed if an entry is later deferred.
